tagline.en: The eastern edge of the north-east: coal towns of Heilongjiang, the Changbai mountains and the Yalu to the Yellow Sea at Dalian
tagline.zh: 东北的东缘：从黑龙江煤城，穿长白山区，经鸭绿江畔丹东抵黄海边的大连

start.en: Nanfengjing in Xing'an district, Hegang, Heilongjiang, at China National Highway 201 — kilometre 0
start.zh: 黑龙江省鹤岗市兴安区南风景，接 201 国道——零公里点

end.en: Houyan interchange in Dalian, Liaoning, where the road meets Huabei Road and Long'an Road — kilometre 1,440
end.zh: 辽宁省大连市后盐立交，接华北路与龙安路——1,440 公里处

en: G11 is the first of the north–south lines in the national expressway plan, 1,440 km on the national chainage down the eastern side of the three north-eastern provinces. From Hegang it crosses the Songhua at Jiamusi and runs south through the coal and power towns of Huanan, Qitaihe and Jixi to Linkou and Mudanjiang, then by Ning'an and Jingpo Lake into Jilin. There it goes through Dunhua, Fusong, Baishan and Tonghua on the western side of the Changbai mountains, crosses into Liaoning at Xinkailing, and comes down by Huanren and Kuandian to Dandong on the Yalu. The last 290 km run west along the Yellow Sea coast by Donggang and Zhuanghe to Dalian.

Heilongjiang has 509.8 km, Jilin 446.5 km and Liaoning 484.0 km. It shares about 15 km with G10 at Mudanjiang and short stretches with other expressways near Baishan and Tonghua. Its role in the plans is to tie the forest, coal and border districts of the east to the ports of Dandong and Dalian; when the Dandong–Tonghua section opened it was presented as the eastern north-east's main outlet to the sea.
zh: G11 是国家高速公路网南北纵线中的第一纵，按国家里程桩号全长 1,440 公里，纵贯东北三省东部。它自鹤岗在佳木斯跨过松花江，向南经桦南、七台河、鸡西等煤电城市至林口、牡丹江，再经宁安、镜泊湖进入吉林；在吉林境内沿长白山西侧经敦化、抚松、白山、通化，于新开岭进入辽宁，经桓仁、宽甸下到鸭绿江畔的丹东。最后约 290 公里沿黄海岸向西，经东港、庄河抵大连。
黑龙江段 509.8 公里，吉林段 446.5 公里，辽宁段 484.0 公里。它在牡丹江与 G10 绥满高速共线约 15 公里，在白山、通化附近也与其他高速公路有短距离共线。在规划中，它的作用是把东部的林区、煤炭基地和边境地区与丹东港、大连港连起来；丹通段通车时被称为打通了东北东部出海大通道。

en: The hardest part is Jilin's 339 km between the Heilongjiang line and Tonghua, through the Changbai mountain forest. It has 90 large bridges with a combined length of 38.2 km and 18 tunnels totalling 31.1 km. It was the Ministry of Transport's first 'double demonstration' project for a new road in a seasonally frozen region, for resource recycling and for low-carbon construction: asphalt plants ran on gas rather than diesel, tunnel spoil and waste tyres went into the road, frost-resistant pavements and insulated tunnels were used, and at the Yanming Lake wetland near Dunhua the builders worked from the old road to spare the marsh.

Liaoning's Dandong–Tonghua section was described when work began as the province's most expensive and most heavily bridged and tunnelled expressway, at more than 60 million yuan a kilometre in Dandong. In Heilongjiang most of the 330 km from Jiamusi to Mudanjiang was built in 2009–2011 by upgrading existing first- and second-class roads. The last piece, the 25 km bypass of Jiamusi opened in 2022, takes the road over the Songhua on a new bridge west of the city instead of through it.
zh: 最难的是吉林境内黑吉界至通化的 339 公里，穿行于长白山林区。全线有大桥 90 座、合计 38.2 公里，隧道 18 座、合计 31.1 公里。它是交通运输部在季节性冻土地区新建公路的首个「双示范」工程——资源节约循环利用科技示范和绿色循环低碳主题性项目：沥青拌合站「油改气」，隧道弃渣、废旧轮胎用于筑路，推广抗冻耐久路面和隧道保温防冻技术；在敦化雁鸣湖湿地，施工便道建在原有道路上，以减少对湿地的扰动。
辽宁丹通段开工时被称为全省地形最复杂、桥隧比例最高、投资最大的高速公路，丹东境内平均每公里造价 6,000 多万元。黑龙江境内佳木斯至牡丹江的 330 公里大部分在 2009—2011 年由既有一、二级公路改扩建而成。最后一段——2022 年通车的 25 公里佳木斯过境段——在城西新建松花江特大桥，使过境交通不再穿城。

en: Most of G11 was built after the line was numbered in the 2005 national expressway plan. The first long stretch was on the coast, where the Dalian–Zhuanghe expressway already existed: the 136.3 km Dandong–Zhuanghe expressway, begun on 20 August 2003 and opened on 28 September 2005, joined it to Dandong and completed Liaoning's coastal expressway from Shanhaiguan round to Dandong.

The rest came in a rush between 2009 and 2016. Heilongjiang opened Jiamusi–Mudanjiang on 28 September 2011, and Ning'an–Fuxing, to the Jilin line, had opened by early October. Jilin's 52 km from Tonghua to the Liaoning line opened on 1 October 2011, and Liaoning's Dandong–Tonghua section on 26 September 2012, one of five Liaoning expressways opened that day. The shared section with the Yingkou–Songjiang expressway near Fusong opened in 2015, and the 339 km through the Changbai mountains, begun in April 2014, on 27 October 2016; the contractor said it cut the drive from Dunhua to Dalian from 14 hours to 7.

That left the Jiamusi bypass, where traffic still went through the city and over its only, 17.5-metre-wide Songhua bridge. It was planned as Heilongjiang's first public–private partnership expressway; in 2018 the Ministry of Finance dropped it from its list of model PPP projects as not yet under way, but it was built anyway and opened on 8 November 2022.
zh: G11 的大部分路段是 2005 年国家高速公路网规划编号之后才修建的。最早成段的是沿海一端，那里已有大庄高速：136.3 公里的丹东至庄河高速公路 2003 年 8 月 20 日开工，2005 年 9 月 28 日通车，与大庄高速相接直达丹东，辽宁自山海关至丹东的沿海高速公路通道由此贯通。

其余路段集中在 2009 至 2016 年间建成。黑龙江佳木斯至牡丹江段于 2011 年 9 月 28 日交工通车，宁安至复兴（黑吉界）段至 10 月初也已通车。吉林通化至新开岭（吉辽界）52 公里于 2011 年 10 月 1 日通车；辽宁丹通段于 2012 年 9 月 26 日通车，是辽宁当天同时开通的五条高速公路之一。抚松附近与营松高速共用的路段于 2015 年通车；2014 年 4 月开工、穿越长白山区的 339 公里于 2016 年 10 月 27 日通车，据施工单位称，敦化至大连的车程由 14 小时缩短为 7 小时。
剩下的是佳木斯过境段：此前过境车辆须穿城而过，走市区唯一一座、桥宽仅 17.5 米的松花江公路大桥。该项目被定为黑龙江第一个以 PPP 模式建设的高速公路项目；2018 年财政部以「尚未落地」为由将其调出示范项目清单，但工程仍继续推进，于 2022 年 11 月 8 日通车。

en: No total for the whole road has been published. The section figures run from 3.47 billion yuan budgeted for the 136 km of Dandong–Zhuanghe (2003–2005) to 25.1 billion for Jilin's 339 km through the mountains (2014–2016), which Jilin called the largest investment in any expressway in the province.

Most sections were provincial projects repaid from tolls. The Jiamusi bypass was financed as a public–private partnership: of a budget of about 2.1 billion yuan, the province planned to put in 585 million from the central vehicle-purchase-tax fund as the government's equity, the city was to pay for land, and the rest was to be raised by the project company, according to the 2018 tender.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。分段数字从丹庄段 136 公里概算 34.7 亿元（2003—2005），到吉林穿越山区的 339 公里概算 251 亿元（2014—2016）——吉林称其为全省投资最大的高速公路。
大部分路段为省级项目，以通行费还贷。佳木斯过境段采用 PPP 模式：据 2018 年招标公告，约 21 亿元的总投资中，省交通运输厅拟申请中央车辆购置税补助资金 5.85 亿元，作为政府方资本金注入；征地拆迁费由佳木斯市承担；其余由项目公司筹措。

why.en: No total has been published. G11 was built by three provinces as about ten separately financed projects between the early 2000s and 2022, each accounted for on its own; sourced section figures are given below.
why.zh: 全线没有公开的总造价。G11 由三省在 2000 年代初至 2022 年间分约十个项目分别筹资建设、分别核算；下列为有来源的分段数字。

value.en: Jiamusi–Mudanjiang upgrade, 330 km: 3.17 billion yuan (2009–2011), per the Ministry of Environmental Protection's acceptance letter; an encyclopedia entry gives 3.04 billion for Jixi–Mudanjiang and 1.68 billion for Qitaihe–Jixi, which does not agree. Jiamusi bypass, about 25 km: about 2.105 billion budgeted (2022; a consultant's case study gives 2.093 billion).
value.zh: 佳木斯至牡丹江段扩建 330 公里：据环境保护部竣工环保验收函，工程总投资 31.7 亿元（2009—2011）；百科条目另称鸡西至牡丹江段 30.4 亿元、七台河至鸡西段 16.8 亿元，与之不符。佳木斯过境段约 25 公里：工程总投资约 21.05 亿元（2022；咨询机构案例介绍作 20.93 亿元）。

figures.source: Ministry of Environmental Protection, acceptance letter on the Jiamusi–Mudanjiang expansion, January 2015; Baidu Baike, 鹤岗—大连高速公路; Heilongjiang Expressway Construction Bureau, PPP tender notice, via 9to.com; Jumbo consultancy (jumbocn.com) case study

value.en: Dunhua–Tonghua (Xiaogouling–Fusong and Jingyu–Tonghua), 339 km: 25.1 billion yuan budgeted (2014–2016). Tonghua–Xinkailing, 52.4 km: 3.12 billion (opened 2011).
value.zh: 敦化至通化（小沟岭至抚松、靖宇至通化）339 公里概算 251 亿元（2014—2016）；通化至新开岭段 52.4 公里 31.2 亿元（2011 年通车）。

figures.source: Jilin Provincial Department of Transport, 30 June 2016 (China Jilin Net); China National Radio (Jilin), 27 September 2012

value.en: Dandong–Zhuanghe, 136.3 km: 3.47 billion yuan budgeted (2003–2005). Dandong–Tonghua, Liaoning part, about 197 km: 12.3 billion budgeted at the start of work in 2008; an encyclopedia entry gives 11.879 billion. Neither checked against the provincial transport department's final accounts.
value.zh: 丹东至庄河段 136.3 公里概算 34.7 亿元（2003—2005）；丹通段辽宁境内约 197 公里，2008 年开工时概算 123 亿元，百科条目作 118.79 亿元，均未与省交通厅决算核对。

figures.source: Xinhua, 28 September 2005, via Sina; Huashang Morning Post, 21 September 2005, via Sina; Dandong city report on the start of works, via weizhang8.cn; Baidu Baike, 通丹高速公路

value.en: The three provinces, section by section, repaid from tolls. The Jiamusi bypass is a public–private partnership; its 2018 tender planned 585 million yuan of central vehicle-purchase-tax funds as government equity.
value.zh: 三省分段出资建设，以通行费还贷。佳木斯过境段为 PPP 项目，2018 年招标公告拟以中央车购税资金 5.85 亿元作为政府方资本金。

figures.source: Heilongjiang Expressway Construction Bureau, PPP tender notice, via 9to.com; Chinese Wikipedia, 鹤岗－大连高速公路

value.en: 1,440 km on the national chainage: 509.8 km in Heilongjiang, 446.5 km in Jilin, 484.0 km in Liaoning
value.zh: 按国家里程桩号 1,440 公里：黑龙江 509.8 公里，吉林 446.5 公里，辽宁 484.0 公里

figures.source: Ministry of Transport, 交公路发〔2008〕157号, as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 鹤岗－大连高速公路

timeline.en: Work on the Dandong–Zhuanghe expressway begins on 20 August.
timeline.zh: 8 月 20 日，丹庄高速公路开工。

timeline.en: The national expressway plan numbers the line G11; Dandong–Zhuanghe opens on 28 September.
timeline.zh: 国家高速公路网规划将该线编为 G11；9 月 28 日丹庄高速通车。

timeline.en: Heilongjiang begins rebuilding Jiamusi–Mudanjiang in May.
timeline.zh: 5 月，黑龙江佳木斯至牡丹江段改扩建开工。

timeline.en: Jiamusi–Mudanjiang opens on 28 September; Tonghua–Xinkailing in Jilin on 1 October.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日佳牡段交工通车；10 月 1 日吉林通化至新开岭段通车。

timeline.en: Dandong–Tonghua opens in Liaoning on 26 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 26 日，辽宁丹通段通车。

timeline.en: Work on the 339 km through the Changbai mountains begins in April.
timeline.zh: 4 月，穿越长白山区的 339 公里开工。

timeline.en: The Jilin mountain section opens on 27 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 27 日，吉林山区段通车。

timeline.en: The Ministry of Finance drops the Jiamusi bypass from its list of model PPP projects.
timeline.zh: 财政部将佳木斯过境段调出 PPP 示范项目清单。

timeline.en: The Jiamusi bypass opens on 8 November, closing the last gap.
timeline.zh: 11 月 8 日，佳木斯过境段通车，最后缺口打通。
